tools.name: get_track

tools.name: get_artist

tools.name: library_list

tools.name: playlist_get
tools.description: One of the person's own playlists with its tracks in order. ownEntries are the person's own files added in the Bitsound app (title, artist, album and duration only, they cannot be played or edited here).

tools.name: wishlist_list
tools.description: Releases on the person's wishlist with prices and the total.

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: The person's Bitsound credit balance in EUR, split into paid credits and free promo vouchers from Bitsound (with scope and expiry). Promo credit is spent first, does not pay out and expires on its date. Credits are topped up and spent only on the website.

tools.name: playlist_create
tools.description: Create a new playlist for the person, optionally with tracks (track IDs from get_release).

tools.name: playlist_update
tools.description: Change title, description or visibility of one of the person's playlists.

tools.name: playlist_add_tracks
tools.description: Append published tracks to one of the person's playlists in the given order, in one step. Tracks already in it are skipped, unknown or unpublished ones are counted as unavailable.

tools.name: playlist_remove_tracks
tools.description: Remove tracks from one of the person's playlists.

tools.name: playlist_delete
tools.description: Delete one of the person's playlists. This cannot be undone, ask the person first.

tools.name: wishlist_set
tools.description: Put a published release on the person's wishlist or take it off.

tools.name: download_link
tools.description: A download link for a release (ZIP of the owned tracks) or a single track the person has bought. It is valid for 15 minutes and only for this person: give it to them directly, never put it into a public text, comment or post. Signed in with another account it does not work.

tools.name: purchase_prepare
tools.description: Never buys anything and never spends money. Checks prices for releases or tracks and returns links where the person confirms the purchase in the browser. With addToCart the items are put into the person's Bitsound cart, which the person checks out on the website.

tools.name: cart_list
tools.description: The person's Bitsound cart: titles, prices, total, credit balance and the amount missing.

tools.name: cart_remove
tools.description: Remove releases or tracks from the person's cart, or empty it with all.

tools.name: redeem_code
tools.description: Redeem a Bitsound code for the signed-in person: a download code from an artist (BSND-XXXX-XXXX, puts a release or track into the collection) or a gift code (GIFT-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX: music given as a gift, a free promo voucher from Bitsound, or a gift card bought earlier). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: catalog_search, studio_release_create, studio_upload_finish, studio_release_submit, studio_release_update, studio_comment_reply, studio_free_access_create · Private data: playlist_get, studio_release_create, studio_upload_prepare, studio_upload_finish, studio_comment_reply, studio_free_access_create · Public sink: download_link, studio_release_create, studio_upload_prepare, studio_upload_finish, studio_release_submit, studio_free_access_create · Destructive: playlist_remove_tracks, playlist_delete, cart_remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: catalog_search, studio_release_create, studio_upload_finish, studio_release_submit, studio_release_update, studio_comment_reply, studio_free_access_create · Private data: playlist_get, studio_release_create, studio_upload_prepare, studio_upload_finish, studio_comment_reply, studio_free_access_create · Public sink: download_link, studio_release_create, studio_upload_prepare, studio_upload_finish, studio_release_submit, studio_free_access_create · Destructive: playlist_remove_tracks, playlist_delete, cart_remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
